entities.summary: Anton Karlsson is a Swedish professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing with Fife Flyers in the UK's Elite Ice Hockey League (EIHL). He was selected in the 5th round by Lokomotiv Yaroslavl in the 2013 KHL Junior Draft and was also drafted by the Arizona Coyotes in the third round of the 2014 NHL Entry Draft.
